optimizedDescription.value: Display SDK-computed graph counts, content freshness, derivation compatibility, and coverage diagnostics in text or structured form.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Stats

## Rules

- Signature: `specd graph stats [--config <path> | --path <path>] [--format text|json|toon]`; `--config` and `--path` mutually exclusive.
- Obtain host via `openSpecdHost` from `@specd/sdk`; explicit config uses its path; `--path`/fallback use `allowBootstrapFallback: true`.
- Open via `withOpenGraphProvider`; call provider `getGraphHealth` once. No CLI pre-open lock probe.
- Output format: text shows labeled counts (`Files`, `Documents`, `Symbols`, `Specs`, `Languages`, `Relations`, `Last indexed`) and canonical health diagnostics (aggregate state, global stale latch, content freshness, coverage completeness, schema/generation compatibility, stable reason codes). Explains why graph cannot prove symbol absence.
- Dirty, partial, unknown, or incompatible health MUST NOT be reduced to an unqualified fresh/current message.
- JSON/TOON emit complete `getGraphHealth` result without presenter-side recomputation. Legacy fields (`stale`, `currentRef`, `fingerprintMismatch`) preserved for compatibility.
- Infrastructure error (`GRAPH_BUSY`, `GRAPH_PROVIDER_STALE`, open failure) exits 3.

## Constraints

- CLI does not manage provider lifecycle or health computation inline.
- Zero-value relation counts omitted only from text.
- Call `process.exit(0)` after SDK closes provider.
